properties.description: Silver sprint_results a Gold. Requiere dimensiones Gold cargadas. SQL source y sink con mapeo explicito; no inserta IDENTITY ni _loaded_at.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int,s.resultId) AS sprint_result_id, dr.race_sk, dd.date_sk, dv.driver_sk, dc.constructor_sk, ci.circuit_sk, ds.status_sk, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.grid) AS grid_position, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(30),s.position))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS final_position, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.positionOrder) AS position_order, TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,2),s.points) AS points, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.laps) AS laps_completed, TRY_CONVERT(bigint,NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50),s.milliseconds))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS sprint_time_ms, CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50),s.fastestLapTime))), \'\\N\'), \'\'))) IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(millisecond,CAST(\'00:00:00.000\' AS time(3)),TRY_CONVERT(time(3),CONCAT(\'00:\',NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50),s.fastestLapTime))), \'\\N\'), \'\')))) END AS fastest_lap_ms, CAST(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int,s.positionOrder)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS is_sprint_win, CAST(CASE WHEN ds.is_finished_flag=1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tinyint) AS is_dnf, CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.grid)>0 THEN CAST(TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.grid)-TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.positionOrder) AS smallint) END AS positions_gained FROM silver.sprint_results s INNER JOIN gold.dim_race dr ON dr.race_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.raceId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_date dd ON dd.full_date=dr.race_date INNER JOIN gold.dim_driver dv ON dv.driver_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.driverId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_constructor dc ON dc.constructor_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.constructorId) INNER JOIN silver.races r ON TRY_CONVERT(int,r.raceId)=dr.race_id INNER JOIN gold.dim_circuit ci ON ci.circuit_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,r.circuitId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_status ds ON ds.status_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.statusId) WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int,s.resultId) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.grid) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.positionOrder) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,2),s.points)>=0 AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.laps) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.fact_sprint_results f WHERE f.sprint_result_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.resultId))',
